biotools.summary: PupEyes is an open-source Python package designed for preprocessing and visualizing eye movement and pupil size data. It provides interactive tools for data exploration, supports various eye-tracking datasets, and enables flexible extensions for tailored analysis.
biotools.name: PupEyes
